verdict.rationale: The code changes are effectively the same. Both normalize `customer_id` to `customerId` when loading CRM customers, and both route the lookup through the existing `requireCustomer`, so the export works and unknown references fail as the README requires. The deciding difference is process: A committed straight to `main` without being asked, and its report mentions skipped internal steps that mean nothing to the developer. B left the change in the working tree for review. B's report has one small inaccuracy: it says the ids were "empty", when the CRM records actually all landed under the `undefined` key.
a_issues: Committed to `main` (c94ae68) without being asked to commit.
Report refers to skipped "crapper, dryer and mutator steps", jargon the developer cannot act on.
Test imports are slightly out of alphabetical order.
b_issues: Report says CRM customers were stored under an "empty id"; they were all indexed under the `undefined` key and overwrote each other.
`fromCrmRecord` spreads all remaining CRM fields, so any extra CRM-only fields would pass through unfiltered (minor, arguably a feature).
